messages:
Jordan: Heads up — prospect LargeHealthCo kicked off a vendor risk / CAIQ request for an observability vendor they're evaluating. They also want a short POC to validate private deployment connectivity. Need to confirm who owns SIG/CAIQ answers, what we can disclose, POC data scopes, and any pricing impact for Dedicated/Private. cc Mira, Samira
Mira: I can own the SIG/CAIQ and gap analysis. Quick Q: do we have an existing vendor questionnaire for ObservixCloud? If not I'll pull CAIQ + SIG baseline and mark anything RDW-specific. Timeline: draft in ~48h.
Alex: FYI LargeHealthCo expects HIPAA BAA. That will affect pricing/contract. For Dedicated/Private expect an uplift — looping Legal/Procurement. @Jordan can you share expected QPS & token volumes? sizing will drive costs.
Jordan: They projected ~100 qps steady, peaks to 250 qps for telemetry ingest. POC: 2-week run, limited to non-PHI telemetry (ops logs only).
Samira: For the POC we need: test account with role-limited API key, sample ingest pipeline config, and a minimal infra diagram. Require token scoping (ingest-only) and recommend KV cache disabled for the test. Region required: eu-west-1.
sec-bot: Automated vendor scan: provider 'ObservixCloud' — last external scan 2026-02-12. Highlights: SOC2 Type II in progress, CSPM flags: 2 critical/3 medium. Public IaC repo flagged. Report: https://reports.internal/observix-2026
Mira: Noted. I'll prepare CAIQ/SIG baseline answers and flag items needing vendor attestation (IDs B1, B3). Jordan please upload any CAIQ the vendor already sent — saves time. If none, I'll prefill from public sources and label as 'needs attestation'.
Jordan: They sent a partial CAIQ PDF — uploaded to drive: https://drive.company/largehealthco/observix-caiq.pdf
Samira: POC checklist (quick):
```
- Create test API key (scoped)
- Provide sample logs (anonymized)
- Configure VPC peering or customer-managed VPN
- Verify latency from eu-west-1 (p50 / p95)
- Run ingest for 48h smoke test
```
I'll prep the infra runbook and include commands/snippets for ops.
Alex: Pricing note: Dedicated baseline estimate is $X/month + onboarding fee; Private (on‑prem) has one-time license + support. I'll DM procurement for exact numbers. For HIPAA/BAA we'll need Legal engaged.
Mira: Security tasks for vendor review (short):
1) Verify CAIQ answers vs our control baseline
2) Request evidence for encryption at rest (KMS/HSM) and key rotation
3) Confirm incident response SLA + SOC2 / breach history
4) Validate access controls: RBAC, SSO (SAML/OIDC), MFA enforcement
5) Network controls: VPC peering, IP allowlist, egress filtering
I'll create/update cards on the vendor-risk board and link evidence.
Jordan: Can you add those items to the board and assign to me + Samira? Prospect expects answers by EOW, so need ETA.
Mira: Assigned on board. ETA: draft answers + outstanding items by Thu 03:00 UTC (~48h). If vendor provides a full CAIQ earlier we can move faster.
sec-bot: Reminder: any uploaded evidence must go to secure-drive and set permissions to 'vendor-risk' group. Audit logs will capture access.
Samira: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the POC kick-off with LargeHealthCo for next Monday and include the infra runbook link.
Jordan: Thanks — I'll coordinate pricing/procurement and ping Legal for the BAA. If anything blocks, drop it here and I'll escalate.
